name: apple-native
description: Apple-native integration layer — Shortcuts, Siri, AppleScript/JXA, Omni apps, launchd. Tier 1 execution for macOS/iOS workflows.

shortcuts.name: Hey Siri, send to Meta OS
shortcuts.description: Captures spoken intent, URL, selected text, and current app context. Routes to orchestrator for tier-based execution.
flow: 1. Capture: spoken intent via Siri dictation
3. Capture: current app context (frontmost app name)
4. POST to orchestrator endpoint (local Mac or n8n webhook)
5. Orchestrator picks route: Tier 1 (local) → Tier 2 (Cowork) → Tier 3 (Computer Use)

shortcuts.name: Ask Eagle Eye
shortcuts.description: Routes question or planning request through ClaudeClaw/Qu3bii for natural language processing, then writes results back to OmniPlan/OmniFocus.
flow: 4. Write back to OmniFocus (tasks) or OmniOutliner (plans) via AppleScript

shortcuts.name: Quick Capture to Vault
shortcuts.description: Captures any content (URL, text, image, PDF) and routes to MyMind AI vault for auto-categorization.
flow: 1. Receive shared content via share sheet or dictation
2. Classify content type (URL, text, image, PDF)
3. Send to MyMind AI for auto-categorization

shortcuts.name: Hey Siri, send to Cowork
shortcuts.description: Mobile shortcut to submit tasks to Claude Cowork via Dispatch. For async work continuation while mobile.
flow: 4. Receive task ID for status checking

omni_suite.description: Omni apps serve as structured Akashic-style buffers that agents read from and write to.

apps.name: OmniOutliner
apps.description: Structured outlines tagged by domain (Nonprofit, Eagle Eye, M3TA, Spiritual tech). Agents read for context and write distilled insights back — never raw dumps.

apps.name: OmniFocus
apps.description: Task front-end that agents can read projects/tasks from and write sub-tasks or status updates to.

apps.name: OmniPlan
apps.description: Gantt charts and project timelines. Agents write task sequences and dependency graphs.

apps.name: OmniGraffle
apps.description: Architecture diagrams and process flows. Agents generate via /canvas-gen skill, render in OmniGraffle.

creator_apps.description: Semi-scriptable creator suite. Use AppleScript/Shortcuts for 80-90% of automation, Computer Use only for deep UI tree operations.
pattern: 1. Claude Code / local agents generate: timelines, cut lists, transcripts, effect recipes
2. AppleScript / Shortcuts / native APIs apply them (Tier 1)
3. For 10-20% 'weird UI' jobs (complex plug-ins, deep UI tree): one-off Computer Use session with strict guardrails (Tier 3)

apps.name: Final Cut Pro
apps.computer_use_fallback: Complex plug-in configuration, batch retiming when XML export fails

apps.name: Logic Pro
apps.computer_use_fallback: Deep effect chains, third-party plug-in UIs
